history.administration_response: The General Assembly, in its resolution 69/308, endorsed the roles and responsibilities of the Field Personnel Division and the transfer of the remaining transactional activities to entities outside the Division. Those activities been completed. In addition, the performance and accountability framework, consisting of a concept paper and a background paper that have been sent to the Board under separate cover, had become operational as at 1 April 2016.
